decision_rule_reachability.reason: Frozen cascade verified independently by exhaustive boolean enumeration (invalid -> null; g3_gate & g2_gate & selection_preserved -> DECIDE_SHIP_TFRAME_BROAD; g2_gate & selection_preserved -> DECIDE_SHIP_TFRAME_SCOPED; else -> DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B): all four decision outcomes and all four retrieval-fork values are structurally reachable, and precedence is clean - the invalidity branch is checked first and no branch shadows a later one. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable on the bounded splits (G3 test FA<=0.10 means <=2 of 20 OOS; coverage>=0.50 means >=18 of 36; UP>=0.85 attainable e.g. 6/7=0.857; G1 selection margins 0.9057-1.0 vs the 0.80 bar), so no bar is at a floor/ceiling. Both a positive/support path (G3 gate-met plus ship branches under an attainable G2 UP>=0.85) and a decision-changing alternative (VALID DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B vs MEASUREMENT_INVALID) exist in the rule. Attack on actual triggering: a unified diff shows the runner's metrics path is byte-identical to the parent runner (only EXP_ID/SEED header lines and the liveness predicate differ), so the realized terminal under frozen inputs is predicted unique (COMPLETE / DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B / BOTH_PASS_G3), which the spec and prereg explicitly disclose as a mandated no-refit reproduction whose information is packet validity; the unrealizable branches fail safe - only a bound, never a ship/promotion, can be emitted. Structural reachability plus disclosed reproduction satisfies this check; the single-realizable-terminal concern is recorded as a nonblocking finding.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and strong baselines are operationally distinct and demonstrably able to differ on this task population. Accepted parent evidence shows material separation: AXIS-G3-NEW test Arm A FA 0.10 vs gatefree 0.45 vs incumbent 0.20, and Arm B selective_acc 0.2727 vs Arm A 1.0 at FA 0.05; AXIS-G2-RETEST Arm A FA 0.0 vs Arm B collapse (pooled_false_accept 0.70, gate not met). Gatefree headroom of 0.35-0.40 on FA shows the population is not ceiling/floor locked for the discriminative dimension. Both arms are scored with identical metric definitions and identical gate thresholds (FA<=0.10, cov>=0.50, UP>=0.85); Arm A uses zero fitted parameters while Arm B's (tau, mu) gate is fit on calibration rows only by the frozen lexicographic rule - a comparator-favorable asymmetry, not a treatment-favorable one. No cost metric or denominator is used anywhere in the decision, so no comparator cost dimension is omitted. probe confirmed arm_b never reads its seed argument, so decision-relevant comparator metrics are not seed-dependent.

control_sensitivity.reason: Under the same implementation that will score the experiment, the load-bearing controls are computed, not asserted. Positive control PC-AXIS-G1-ALTLEX derives from the same gate_met path used for the decision gates (parent evidence: ALTLEX FA 0.0556 / cov 0.9464 / UP 1.0 / sel 1.0, gate True); it would flip to False if the shared selector or clause set regressed, so it is not tautological and is not impossible. Primary null NC-EXEC-ALL (gatefree) is computed from the scoring path and moved materially in the parent (FA 0.45 G3 / 0.50 G2 / 0.2778 G1 vs Arm A 0.10 / 0.0 / 0.0556), with genuine headroom to remain null-or-not. CTRL-RANDOM-GATE (FA 0.70), CTRL-SHUFFLED-SELECTION (0.083) and CTRL-RANDOM-ROLE (0.111) are computed per run. A synthetic-row canary through the frozen code reproduced control movement (tframeplus FA 0.0 vs gatefree FA 0.5; C7 fired on the oblique CREATE row producing abstained_resolved=1) and the repaired LIVE formula discriminated non-degenerate from execute-all/abstain-all degeneracy. The hardcoded abstain-all and incumbent-constant output fields are non-load-bearing placeholders and are recorded as nonblocking findings.
evidence_refs: probe: synthetic-row canary of metrics/gate_met/clause_c7 and LIVE-formula degeneracy arithmetic

nonblocking_findings: Single realizable terminal under deterministic reproduction: a unified diff shows this runner differs from the parent runner only in EXP_ID/SEED header lines and the liveness predicate, all inputs are hash-frozen, and arm_b ignores its seed, so the run's decision-relevant metrics are predicted byte-reproducible - the realized terminal is expected unique (COMPLETE / DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B / BOTH_PASS_G3) with DECIDE_SHIP_TFRAME_BROAD, DECIDE_SHIP_TFRAME_SCOPED and MEASUREMENT_INVALID unrealizable in execution. The design discloses this (spec.decision_rule 'BROAD/SCOPED expected-unreachable'; prereg #8.10/#10) and it fails safe (only a bound, never a promotion, can be emitted), so it does not block freeze; but AUDIT/DIRECTOR should classify this packet as a validity-transaction reproduction rather than a discriminating test, and the mandate's 'PASS with ship-scope branch' counterfactual should be treated as arithmetically unavailable under the no-refit constraint.

spec.decision_rule and prereg #9 declare MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC-AXIS-G1-ALTLEX fails, but the frozen runner's invalid_reasons only implements the liveness and unknown_precision-undefined triggers - a PC failure would be emitted as COMPLETE with a decision. Latent (parent evidence: ALTLEX gate True, deterministic), inherited unchanged from the parent runner, and recomputable by AUDIT, but the spec/runner divergence should be reconciled or explicitly delegated to AUDIT before EXECUTE.

Two control fields are hardcoded constants in the runner output rather than computed: ctrl_abstain_all_cov=0.0 / ctrl_abstain_all_up=1.0 and b_incumbent_kernel=0.0. In particular an all-abstain control's unknown_precision under this experiment's own definition would pool applicable and OOS resolved rows (not 1.0), so these fields are placeholders and must not be read as measured control values. The load-bearing controls (NC-EXEC-ALL FA, CTRL-RANDOM-GATE, shuffled/random-role, PC gates) are genuinely computed.

DECIDE_REQUIRE_RETRIEVAL_B is the unconditional else-branch: it fires even if the retrieval fork is NEITHER_PASSES_G3 (Arm B also failing the G3 gate), so the decision label can imply 'require retrieval' in a state where retrieval does not pass either. The fork is emitted separately, and under parent evidence the realized fork is BOTH_PASS_G3, so this label/fork mismatch is unreachable in this transaction but should be read by AUDIT via the fork field, not the decision string alone.

Execution-environment assumptions: the runner hardcodes ROOT=/home/runner/work/Spider/Spider and honors an SPIDER_PREREG environment override for its prereg path. EXECUTE must control SPIDER_PREREG (default path is the frozen prereg) and run in the standard workspace layout; both are inherited from the parent transaction.

Axis-G3-NEW Arm A sits exactly at the FA boundary (pooled_false_accept = 0.10 = 2/20, passing only via '<='). Determinism makes this stable, but any reproduction perturbation would flip the G3 gate and therefore the decision; freeze hashes on the three artifacts plus the canonical runner sha are the mitigation.
rationale: Independent review by a different model (opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free; DESIGN producer was opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free). All six satisfiability/identifiability checks were re-derived from probes rather than accepted from spec.freeze_eligibility: (1) the decision cascade was exhaustively enumerated with sound precedence and attainable thresholds; (2) every runtime prerequisite (Python 3.12.15, stdlib-only, all extracted blocks in the exact frozen files, canonical runner hash under the declared newline convention, handoff sha) was verified present now, not deferred to EXECUTE; (3) treatment and baselines are distinct implementations with demonstrated separation on this population and no asymmetric cost metric; (4) the positive control and primary null are computed by the same scoring path and moved in the parent, confirmed by a synthetic canary; (5) the frozen treatment is live - the analysis path executes on synthetic rows, the repaired liveness predicate evaluates True on parent-published G3-test counts while still rejecting execute-all/abstain-all degeneracy, and mechanics-only canaries are mandated before the scored run; (6) all three mutable local dependencies are bound and no interpretation-relevant file escapes freeze_artifacts. The only deep contest was decision-rule reachability: because the run is a mandated deterministic no-refit reproduction, exactly one terminal is expected in execution, which I record as a loud nonblocking finding rather than a blocker, since the branches are structurally and arithmetically reachable, the predictability is disclosed in the frozen text, the realized outcome fails safe (a valid bound, never a ship promotion), and no legal repair exists within the mandate's stop rules (no refit, no third surface) - REVISE would deadlock a near-zero-cost Director-mandated validity repair that can answer its own question (valid packet, intrinsic G2 shortfall, structure-favouring fork). No check is FAIL; no blocking findings; the experiment is ready to freeze with the listed nonblocking findings carried into AUDIT.
